content: API schema-drift detection is overwhelmingly treated as an INFRASTRUCTURE concern, not an SDK feature: contract tests against an OpenAPI spec in CI (additionalProperties:false to surface undocumented response fields), proxy/traffic-based diffing, and OpenTelemetry-based schema inference from observed attributes. No mainstream Python API client emits per-field divergence records from inside the decode path. Confidence LOW -- results were largely vendor/SEO content rather than primary engineering sources.
